default.$description: The default background for neutral elements, such as default buttons.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the default neutral background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the default neutral background.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements that appear to have no background in a resting state, such as subtle buttons and menu items.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of elements that have no background at rest, such as subtle buttons and menu items.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of elements that have no background at rest.

default.$description: A vibrant background option for neutral UI elements, such as announcement banners.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold neutral background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold neutral background.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements used to reinforce our brand, but with less emphasis.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the subtlest brand background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the subtlest brand background.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements used to reinforce our brand, but with more emphasis. The primary button.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold brand background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold brand background.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements used to reinforce our brand, that need to stand out a lot.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the boldest brand background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the boldest brand background.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements in a selected state, such as the active row, the checked menu item, an opened dropdown button.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the selected background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the selected background.

default.$description: Use for the backgrounds of elements in a selected state, such as checkboxes and radio buttons.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold selected background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold selected background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds communicating critical information, such as in section messages.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the critical information background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the critical information background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds of critical information lozenges and badges.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the subtler critical information background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the subtler critical information background.

subtle.$description: Non-interactive critical information fill, between subtler and bold. Status pills, callout chips.

default.$description: A vibrant background for critical information, such as buttons and banners.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold critical information background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold critical information background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds communicating caution, such as in section messages.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the caution background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the caution background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds of caution lozenges and badges.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the subtler caution background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the subtler caution background.

subtle.$description: Non-interactive caution fill, between subtler and bold. Status pills, callout chips.

default.$description: A vibrant background for caution, such as buttons and banners.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold caution background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold caution background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds communicating a favorable outcome, such as in section messages.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the a favorable outcome background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the a favorable outcome background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds of a favorable outcome lozenges and badges.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the subtler a favorable outcome background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the subtler a favorable outcome background.

subtle.$description: Non-interactive a favorable outcome fill, between subtler and bold. Status pills, callout chips.

default.$description: A vibrant background for a favorable outcome, such as buttons and banners.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold a favorable outcome background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold a favorable outcome background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds communicating information or something in progress, such as in section messages.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the information or something in progress background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the information or something in progress background.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds of information or something in progress lozenges and badges.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the subtler information or something in progress background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the subtler information or something in progress background.

subtle.$description: Non-interactive information or something in progress fill, between subtler and bold. Status pills, callout chips.

default.$description: A vibrant background for information or something in progress, such as buttons and banners.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the bold information or something in progress background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the bold information or something in progress background.

disabled.$description: Use for backgrounds of elements in a disabled state.

default.$description: Use for background of form UI elements, such as text fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of form UI element backgrounds.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of form UI element backgrounds.

default.$description: Use for backgrounds of elements on a bold background, such as buttons on spotlight cards.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the inverse subtle background.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the inverse subtle background.

subtler.$description: A blue tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.blue.

bolder.$description: A blue fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

subtler.$description: A teal tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.teal.

bolder.$description: A teal fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

subtler.$description: A green tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.green.

bolder.$description: A green fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

subtler.$description: A orange tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.orange.

bolder.$description: A orange fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

subtler.$description: A red tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.red.

bolder.$description: A red fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

subtler.$description: A purple tint that carries no meaning: an avatar, a tag. Pairs with color.text.accent.purple.

bolder.$description: A purple fill that carries no meaning, for color.text.inverse on it: a bold avatar, one end of a gradient.

default.$description: Use for primary text, such as body copy, sentence case headers, and buttons.

subtle.$description: Use for secondary text, such as navigation, subtle button links, input field labels, and all caps subheadings.

subtlest.$description: Use for tertiary text, such as metadata, breadcrumbs, placeholder and helper text.

disabled.$description: Use for text in a disabled state.

inverse.$description: Use for text on bold backgrounds.

selected.$description: Use for text in selected or opened states, such as tabs and dropdown buttons.

brand.$description: Use for text that reinforces our brand.

default.$description: Use for critical text, such as input field error messaging.

bolder.$description: Use for text on top of danger semantic labels.

default.$description: Use for text to emphasize caution.

inverse.$description: Use for text when on bold warning backgrounds.

bolder.$description: Use for text on top of warning semantic labels.

default.$description: Use for text to communicate a favorable outcome.

bolder.$description: Use for text on top of success semantic labels.

default.$description: Use for informative text or to communicate something is in progress.

bolder.$description: Use for text on top of information semantic labels.

default.$description: Use for icon-only buttons, or icons paired with color.text.

subtle.$description: Use for icons paired with color.text.subtle.

subtlest.$description: Use for icons paired with color.text.subtlest.

disabled.$description: Use for icons in a disabled state.

inverse.$description: Use for icons on bold backgrounds.

selected.$description: Use for icons in selected or opened states.

brand.$description: Use for icons that reinforce our brand.

danger.$description: Use for icons communicating critical information.

default.$description: Use for icons communicating caution.

inverse.$description: Use for icons when on bold warning backgrounds.

success.$description: Use for icons communicating a favorable outcome.

information.$description: Use for icons communicating information or something in progress.

default.$description: Use to visually group or separate UI elements, such as flat cards or side panel dividers.

bold.$description: A neutral border option that passes min 3:1 contrast ratios.

disabled.$description: Use for borders of elements in a disabled state.

focused.$description: Use for focus rings of elements in a focus state.

input.$description: Borders of form UI elements, such as text fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons. A light boundary by decision (2026-09-04): the input surface, the hover tint and the focus and danger borders carry the affordance.

inverse.$description: Use for borders on bold backgrounds.

selected.$description: Use for borders or visual indicators of elements in a selected or opened state, such as tabs or menu items.

brand.$description: Use for borders of elements that reinforce our brand, such as primary buttons.

default.$description: Use for borders communicating critical information.

subtle.$description: Use for decorative critical information borders that do not need to meet 3:1 contrast.

default.$description: Use for borders communicating caution.

subtle.$description: Use for decorative caution borders that do not need to meet 3:1 contrast.

default.$description: Use for borders communicating a favorable outcome.

subtle.$description: Use for decorative a favorable outcome borders that do not need to meet 3:1 contrast.

default.$description: Use for borders communicating information.

subtle.$description: Use for decorative information borders that do not need to meet 3:1 contrast.

blanket.$description: Use for the screen overlay that appears with modal dialogs.

default.$description: Use for skeleton loading states.

subtle.$description: Use for the pulse or shimmer effect in skeleton loading states.

default.$description: The brand series: the one the reader is asked to look at. The same step in both modes, so a chart weighs the same on either surface.

hovered.$description: The brand series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: A series that is context, not the point: totals, the remainder, last period, the tail folded into Other. Also the threshold line.

hovered.$description: The neutral series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: A series carrying an informational status: in progress, planned.

hovered.$description: The information series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: A series carrying a success status: satisfied, closed, on time.

hovered.$description: The success series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: A series carrying a warning status: partial, at risk, due soon.

hovered.$description: The warning series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: A series carrying a danger status: other than satisfied, overdue, open.

hovered.$description: The danger series under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

track.$description: The unfilled part of a ring or bar: the whole against which a series is read.

default.$description: Categorical series 1, blue. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 1 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 2, orange. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 2 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 3, teal. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 3 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 4, red. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 4 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 5, purple. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 5 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 6, green. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 6 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

default.$description: Categorical series 7: Other, the fold for every category past the sixth. Grey on purpose, the same as color.chart.neutral.

hovered.$description: The categorical series 7 under the pointer: one step darker in light, one lighter in dark.

8.$description: Deprecated: there is no eighth category. Six hues, then Other (categorical.7).

1.$description: Sequential step 1 of 5, near zero: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

2.$description: Sequential step 2 of 5, low: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

3.$description: Sequential step 3 of 5, middle: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

4.$description: Sequential step 4 of 5, high: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

5.$description: Sequential step 5 of 5, the most: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

default.$description: Diverging, the negative arm's inner step: a little below the midpoint.

bold.$description: Diverging, the negative arm's outer step: far below the midpoint. The arm that means below, behind, under, over budget.

midpoint.$description: Diverging, the midpoint: at the line, nothing to say. Grey, never a hue.

default.$description: Diverging, the positive arm's inner step: a little above the midpoint.

bold.$description: Diverging, the positive arm's outer step: far above the midpoint. Blue against red: warm against cool, so the two arms read as opposites.

small.$description: Small control height. Button sm, chips, menu items, sidebar items.

medium.$description: Default control height. Button md, inputs, selects, combobox triggers.

large.$description: Large control height. Reserved for hero forms.

default.$description: Default table row.

small.$description: Icon inside a small or medium control.

sidenav.$description: The side nav, expanded. The reader may resize it.

banner.$description: The banner area above the top nav, when one is shown.

panel.$description: The panel beside the main area, before the reader resizes it.

list.$description: The list column of a WorkPane.

rail.$description: The rail beside a record page: PreviewRail, the Inspector, the ShowPage rail.

measure.$description: The widest a run of prose grows: statements, notes, descriptions.

default.$description: Use as the primary background for the UI.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of the primary surface.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of the primary surface.

sunken.$description: A secondary background for the UI commonly used for grouping items, such as a sidebar.

default.$description: Use for the background of raised cards, with elevation.shadow.raised.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of raised surfaces.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of raised surfaces.

default.$description: Use for the background of elements that sit on top of the UI, such as modals, dropdown menus, flags and inline dialogs, with elevation.shadow.overlay.

hovered.$description: Hovered state of overlay surfaces.

pressed.$description: Pressed state of overlay surfaces.

raised.$description: Use for the box shadow of raised card elements, such as cards on a board.

overlay.$description: Use for the box shadow of elements that sit on top of the UI, such as modals, menus and popovers.

overflow.$description: Use to create a shadow when content scrolls under other content, such as a scrolling table.

current.$description: The surface an element currently sits on. Surface-owning components set this variable; sticky and masking children read it.

body.$description: The one UI face. Identifiers, dates and numbers use it too.

heading.$description: Same face as body today; a token so a theme may split them.

code.$description: Code blocks and data previews only. Never UI text.

medium.$description: Labels, UI headings, emphasis inside body text.

500.$description: Uppercase micro labels: eyebrows, group headings.

small.$description: Table headers, field labels, badges, KeyValue. Labels add font.weight.medium.

default.$description: Controls, cells, tabs, inputs, menu items. The UI size.

large.$description: Display: a stat value, a dashboard number. Not a page title.

medium.$description: Page and record titles. The only semibold.

xxsmall.$description: Eyebrows, group headings and menu section labels. The component adds the uppercase.

micro.$description: A toggle's thumb, a checkbox's tick, a chevron turning: the smallest moves.

fast.$description: Hover and press colour, a tooltip's fade, a menu or a popover leaving.

medium.$description: A menu or a popover arriving, a section expanding or collapsing, a dialog or a sheet leaving.

moderate.$description: A dialog or a sheet arriving, the panel sliding in, a toast, a page's content rising.

slow.$description: Marks arriving on a chart, and a drill-down redrawing it.

slower.$description: The blanket dimming the page under a dialog or a sheet.

stagger.$description: Between one item's entrance and the next when a set arrives together: tiles, cards. Six at most, so the last lands within a moderate duration.

standard.$description: For what stays on screen throughout: colour, a chevron, a sort, a side panel leaving.

enter.$description: For what arrives: in quickly, slowing to a stop.

exit.$description: For what leaves for good: speeding up out of view.

disabled.$description: Use for the opacity of disabled elements when a disabled token does not exist.

loading.$description: Use for the opacity of content in a loading state.

xsmall.$description: Draft, on a 5px base. Checkbox, tiny chips.

small.$description: Draft. Badges, count chips, Kbd, skeleton, inline hit targets.

medium.$description: Draft. Buttons, inputs, chips, menu items.

selected.$description: The width used to indicate a selected element, such as an active tab or a chosen item.

focused.$description: The width used for the focus ring on interactive elements.

default.$description: The default width for all standard component borders and dividers.

100.$description: Standard small: control clusters, chip rows.

150.$description: Standard medium: cell padding, card header inset.

200.$description: Standard large: card padding, form grids.
